title: Private Safari or Group Safari?
excerpt: A private safari gives you freedom and flexibility, a group safari is more social and cheaper. Which suits you?
body:
In Tanzania, you can go on safari privately (your own vehicle and guide) or with a group.

## Private safari

- Your own vehicle and guide.
- You choose departure times and how long you stay at a sighting.
- Ideal for families, couples and photographers.
- More expensive per person, especially for small groups.

## Group safari

- You share the vehicle with other travellers.
- Fixed itinerary and dates.
- Social, good for solo travellers.
- Lower price per person.

## Window seats

Make sure every traveller has a window seat. See [safari vehicles explained](/blog/safari-vehicles-explained/).

## Our approach

We plan tailor-made private safaris with our partner Kilimanjaro Nature Tours. See [how a tailor-made trip works](/blog/how-a-tailor-made-trip-works/).
